items.summary: First checked radar separates three official application routes from one past-deadline route, one referral-only route and one unconfirmed hosted-form lead.
Added Aster, Elk and Nomis to the checked open table; added Bitget’s 30 Sep Trading Builder deadline and SideShift’s closed status.
Rechecked the open routes and added MetaMask as a voluntary unpaid role with no confirmed current public form; the six tracked open routes remain.

Soneium entered the open table after its official page explicitly said applications were open; added Torium’s open route and conditional reward terms; moved Nexo out after its tracked ambassador URL redirected to the general site.
Returned Nexo to the open table after its official form rendered again; added Oasis Sentinels and Fiber Community Ambassador routes with their stated fit, payment and data gaps.

Added Bybit Africa Campus and HeLa application routes; made Torium’s 50K-view entry threshold for its stated $100 USDT reward explicit; separated Pendulum Discord enrollment and held Wager Predict out for incomplete terms.
Added Cronos and Zerion routes; made their rolling review, unspecified reward terms and possible identity-data escalation visible before application.
Added Injective’s issuer-linked Zealy route with its incomplete INJ reward terms; separated Arc’s contribution-based Architects program and BNB’s expired old Martians form from formal applications.

Added Stellar Ambassadors, Midnight Nightforce and Thrilld Labs as issuer or issuer-partner application routes; made the Stellar trial, Midnight volunteer status and Thrilld’s unpublished KPI compensation terms visible.

Added the MiCA Crypto Alliance and Autheo application routes. MiCA’s €1,000 applies only to each approved, delivered event and its proposed €3,000 event budget is not personal compensation; Autheo publishes five seats and a monthly content commitment but no reward terms.

Moved PIVX from referral-only to not confirmed. Its official page still links a referral form, but a PIVX staff administrator says the Q3 programme was not approved and has no budget or allocated funds for payments. Held out Party Knights pending governance approval and a live join route.

Added HPP Party Knights Cohort 2 as a held-out lead. Its timeline named 23 Sep for confirmation, but the official pages checked did not show a formal proposal, approval result or public join route. Refreshed Hedera, Cyfrin, Soneium, Injective and MetaMask route checks.

Added Sogo’s open ambassador route as referral commission rather than a wage. Its issuer page requires a good-standing account and Tier 2 KYC via BVN or NIN before application; referred users also need Tier 2 KYC before qualifying trades create commission. Rechecked Bitget’s 30 Sep deadline.

Rechecked eight issuer routes; their displayed routes remain visible and Bitget still names 30 Sep as its close. Added RabbitHole only as a held-out lead because the issuer documentation linked from community posts was unavailable to inspect, so no application or bounty claim was verified.
